fix: For a killed gate, the offender text names the kill (elapsed, budget, the last package started) and never lists ok lines; ORCHESTRATOR_SYSTEM_FAILURE with category infra-systemic carries free_disk_pct from the host probe.
summary: Wave 182: the first symptom of the disk-full hang was AUDIT_CIPARITY_GATE_FAILED whose reason listed passing 'ok' lines: go/internal/ciparitygate/offenders.go:30-60 falls back to the first 6 output lines when a gate is killed (exit=-1).
title: a killed gate reports passing ok lines as its offenders, so the failure signal hides the cause
